# OpenAgent

> Digital marketing studio specialising in real estate and interior design, run by one person. Founded by Abeer Nasir, based in Karachi, Pakistan.

OpenAgent helps real estate agents, property developers, interior designers and fit-out studios attract high-value clients online — with Meta & Google Ads, SEO, websites, video content and AI automation. Practical solutions, direct communication, no jargon. Every project is handled personally by Abeer Nasir.

## Key facts

- Founder: Abeer Nasir (independent operator — no team, no middlemen)
- Specialist focus: real estate marketing and interior design marketing
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan — works with clients worldwide
- Direct contact on every project
- Contact: WhatsApp +92 370 3159642 · Email abeerinfo5566@gmail.com
